description: This file is a shell script for testing Git submodule stash operations, including setup, stash push, stash pop, and validation of submodule worktrees. It defines functions to handle Git stash behaviors with submodules, sets up test repositories, and runs specific test cases related to submodule state preservation during stash operations.

methods.description: Function to perform Git stash operations with verification of submodule states.
